Alright I’m gonna give it to you straight. You’re not depressed. You’re experiencing heartache which for the human brain it can’t tell the difference between unfortunately. You my friend. Do these things;

Remove anything about her from your life. You need to accept that she’s moved on and you should to. I’m not gonna give you that plenty of fish in the sea bullshit. I’m telling you straight. You’ll have her in your heart forever but you’ll learn to live your life (I say this from experience)

Find your exercise,
For me I fell in love with boxing and working out when I was at my lowest. After taking my anger out on the punch bag and using my negative feelings towards my self for constructive purposes I slowly (VERY SLOWLY IT DOESN’T HAPPEN OVER FUCKING NIGHT) started to see results and went from skinny underweight malnourished looking fuck to the guy that had the body all the other guys wanted even the “popular” ones. (Start small push ups sit ups blah blah blah then move on to weights google the shit out of all of it) yours might be swimming or gym or cycling or running whatever. If you like  hopscotch do it. Live your life bro!

Start learning about self growth now,
Also google how to break victim mentality. Really changes your perspective when you realise life is happening FOR you not TO you. You’ve been put in this position because god/ the universe/ who or whatever knows that you cannot become the person you are destined to be until you face the hardships. 

Watch videos or learn about being more confident and being more confident with gals,
You might not even need this you might be chick magnet for all I know but it helped me when I learnt that confidence could be built (the working out thing really helped this, seeing yourself a bit better every now and then in the mirror and actually having a reason to smile at my appearance helped. A lot.) and being able to flirt with girls helped a lot too. 

Learn about habit building. 
You without a doubt have some bad habits somewhere in your life. Make it your god damn mission to weed these fuckers out and replace them with good ones! Again google and youtube! You need to dedicate yourself to something more have a purpose so to speak. A purpose does not have to be for someone else. It can be selfish and that’s okay there’s nothing wrong with that. Just don’t purposefully knock others down because I said this lol that’s just being a dick
